A `confirmed` action receipt proves dispatch, not"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" the application's business outcome."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| `browser_session_start` | Discover installed Chrome/Edge/Chromium and start one isolated context. "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"|
| `browser_observe` | Return a bounded semantic view — whole-page, or scoped to one element's subt"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ree via `within` — with opaque epoch/fingerprint/expiry-bound refs. |
| `browser_act` | `click`, `fi"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ll`, `press`, `navigate`, `scroll`, `select`, or `hover` after live re-resolution and target checks."},{"id":"p23s5","text":" |
| `browser_evidence` | Return bounded, redacted console and network metadata. |
| `browser_sessio"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"n_stop` | Close the context and delete its exact temporary profile directory. |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Every `browser_act` result is a receipt with one of four states:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- `confirmed`: the browser completed the validated dispatch. This does **not** claim the application"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"'s business outcome succeeded.
- `unknown`: dispatch may have happened, but cancellation/navigation/"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"runtime failure made the resulting page state uncertain.
- `rejected`: policy, stale-ref, semantic-c"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"hange, expiry, or hit-test checks stopped dispatch.
- `failed`: the browser could not dispatch the a"},{"id":"p25s5","text":" expiry, or hit-test checks stopped dispatch.
- `failed`: the browser could not dispatch the action."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"`scroll` reaches off-viewport controls (by ref, centering the target) or pages the viewport (`direct"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ion` + optional `amount`); `select` chooses a native `<select>` option by accessible label first and"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" exact value second, failing rather than guessing; `hover` holds the pointer over an element so a la"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ter observe sees hover-revealed content. The packed smoke performs a real clean npm instal"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"l and starts the installed package's managed browser."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Initial limitations are intentional and should not be read as claims:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- Chromium-family browsers only; Firefox and WebKit are not implemented.
- Main-document semantic DO"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"M projection. Any `<iframe>`/`<frame>` content — same-origin included — is out of scope for now: the"},{"id":"p32s3","text":" observation sets `truncated` with reason `iframe-not-traversed`. Content a closed shadow root rende"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"rs — including elements assigned to a slot inside one — is never pierced, only detected: with `verif"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"yCoverage` the bounded CDP probe marks such roots with `closed-shadow-root` (see the Verified bounda"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"ries section); without it the projection covers observable semantic nodes only and makes no closed-r"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"oot claim.
- `visualObserve` performs capture only (pixels + Set-of-Mark labels); visual understandi"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"ng is delegated to the DSH harness vision model.
- The driver never attaches to an existing browser "},{"id":"p32s9","text":"profile, browser extension, or signed-in tab. - Headless mode is the accepted path; the availabl"},{"id":"p32s12","text":"e headful option has not received the same integration coverage.
